Execution Copy ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENTisentered intoasofMarch24, 2010 between the NEW YORK CITY HOUSING AUTHORITY, a public benefit corporation established under the laws of theState of NewYork,having an office at 250Broadway,New York, New York 10007, including any successor in interest or assigns by act of the Authority, or by operation of law,or otherwise (the“Authority") and the NewYork City School Construction Authority,a public benefit corporation established under the laws of the State of NewYork, having its principal office at 30-30 Thomson Avenue, Long Island City, New York 11101 ("SCA"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Authority is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, known as Block 2116, Lot 33 (formerly part of Lot 33) on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 1968-1970 Amsterdam Avenue, New York, New York and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being any future replacements or additions thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Authority's Building"); WHEREAS, SCA has acquired a certain portion of the former lot 33 from the Authority, with the improvements thereon, located in the Borough of New York, City'and State of New York, known as Block 2116, Lot 31(formerly part of Lot 33) on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known ·as 508 West 158"h Street, New York, New York and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called "SCA's Property"; WHEREAS,the Authority reserves for itself, its residents its agents, and its.successors, transferees, designees and/or assigns an exclusive, perpetual, permanent easement on SCA's Property adjacent toAuthority's·Building for (i) a six-space parking area and (i)an of the Authority's Property (collectively hereinafter referred to as the “Easement Area". The Easement Area is more fully described in Exhibit B-1; WHEREAS, SCA intends to demolish the existing improvements on SCA's Property to construct thereon a new six (6) story mixed-use facility with a gross floor area of approximately Seventy-Nine Thousand (79,000) square feet or a net floor area of approximately Seventy-Seven Thousand Five Hundred and Ninety-One (77,591) square feet, that will contain a public school facility to be operated by the New York City Department of Education ("DOE"), a community health center, and administrative offices for a multi-service community development corporation (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced from time to time permitted pursuant to this Agreement, “SCA's Building"); H:VThurgood MarshallNThurgood Marshall ZLDA v. 4.doc

WHEREAS, Authority and SCA are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, in order to retain a single zoning lot (the “Merged Zoning Lot") containing the SCA's Property and the Authority's Property in accordance with the terms hereof (said Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as same may hereafter be modified, amended or replaced, being referred to herein as the “Declaration"); and WHEREAS, the Merged Zoning Lot and particularly SCA's Building and the Authority's Building have received Mayoral Zoning Override Approval dated August 17, 2009 ("Mayoral Override Approval") overriding certain non-compliances created by SCA's Building on the Merged Zoning Lot; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises contained herein and other good and valuable consideration the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the partiesherebyagreeasfollows: SECTION1.DEFINITIONS (a)“Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by: (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the floor area ratio established for structures in the zoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located; (ii) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; and (i) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time.· (b)“Excess Development Rights" shall mean: (i) as. of·the date of this Development Rights appurtenant to Authority's Property, which are in excess of the Utilized . Development Rights,and (ii) hereafter,such amount of Development Rights in excess of the Utilized Development Rights pursuant to any validly enacted amendment of the Zoning Resolution and Section 2(f) of this Agreement. appurtenant to the Authority's Property utilized by the Authority's Building as of the date of this Agreement. (d)"Violations” shall mean a violation of the Zoning Resolution or any law, . ordinance, order, requirement, rule or regulation issued by any municipal department or other governmental authority. 2
